prompt:
Hey, I need you to work on two critical things for my workflow. This is part of a coordinated sprint I'm running right now — I have 4 agents working simultaneously on different parts of Mission Control. You're the Beacon agent.

  Your two tasks:
  1. Terminal Identity — I run 3-5 Claude Code sessions at once and every single terminal tab looks identical. "Claude Code" on all of them. I need to glance at a window and instantly know which agent is which. Think terminal titles,
  color coding, something that maps to what the Dashboard shows.
  2. Session End Retrospective — when I type "ending the session," I want a hook or command that fires and captures what happened: accomplishments, decisions, unfinished work, insights. Right now context just evaporates when a session
  ends.

  First thing: read the full brief I prepared for you at:
  C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\.claude\agent-hub\coordinated-sprint\agent-a-terminal-identity.md

  It has everything — technical details, file paths, how I work, what other agents are doing, working agreements so you don't step on files other agents own. Also read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md for the
  non-negotiable behavioral rules.

  Key files you'll be working with:
  - .claude/agent-hub/hook.js (PostToolUse + Stop hook)
  - .claude/agent-hub/prompt-hook.js (PromptSubmit hook)
  - .claude/commands/ (for new slash commands)
  - .claude/agent-hub/states/ (session state files)

  DON'T touch dispatch-page.html, findings.json, server.js, or campaigns-page.html — other agents own those.

  Read the brief, then tell me your plan before you start building.
